enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the space heater off and the room dark
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Breathes deeply. Turns onto back. Stretches legs. Remains still. Turns to left side again. Pulls blanket down slightly. Breathes steadily. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and taking a warm shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands. Brushes teeth. Takes shower. Turns off water. Dries with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Having breakfast with Member 1, using the kettle and toaster, then washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Says 'Good morning' to Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread and milk. Places bread in toaster. Turns on kettle. Pours water into cup. Eats breakfast. Talks with Member 1. Clears table. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag with a sketchbook and laptop
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out clothes. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on shoes. Picks up sketchbook. Picks up laptop. Places them in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts organization office on public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to train station. Waits for train. Boards train. Finds seat. Sits down. Reads book. Gets off train. Walks to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as an arts administrator at the office: meetings, grant paperwork and program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Enters office. Greets colleagues. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens email. Reads emails. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Discusses grant applications. Reviews budget. Makes phone calls. Writes reports. Coordinates with artists. Files paperwork. Organizes schedule. Updates calendar. Attends another meeting. Reviews program details. Sends emails. Prints documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leaves office. Walks to nearby cafe. Enters cafe. Orders food. Pays. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Checks phone. Talks to colleague. Finishes meal. Clears table. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing administrative work and reviewing exhibition schedules at the office
enriched_activities.desc: Continues administrative work. Opens exhibition schedule file. Reviews dates. Contacts venues. Updates spreadsheet. Attends phone conference. Takes notes. Sends emails to artists. Prints contracts. Files documents. Organizes folders. Checks inventory. Orders supplies. Coordinates with team. Updates calendar. Prepares report. Reviews budget. Makes calls. Sends final emails.

Leaves office. Walks to train station. Waits for train. Boards train. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Reads book. Gets off train. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Gets off bus. Walks home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds spices. Turns off stove. Places food on plates. Sets table. Sits down. Eats dinner. Asks Member 1 'How was your day?' Drinks water. Clears plates. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching a short TV program with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches program. Talks with Member 1. Laughs. Comments on the show. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustrations on the computer with the monitor and desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Opens illustration software. Creates new canvas. Sketches with stylus. Adjusts colors. Zooms in. Saves file. Checks email. Continues drawing. Takes break. Stretches. Drinks water. Resumes drawing. Adds details. Saves file. Closes software. Turns off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: washing face, brushing teeth and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.
Enters bedroom. Turns off light. Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns onto back. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep.
